svg.title: EV-001 chronological evaluation protocol
svg.desc: Initial training uses 2020 to 2024 after warmup; 2025 is validation and 2026 is the reserved model test. Earlier validation folds use 2023 and 2024. Targets crossing evaluation boundaries are excluded. Final refitting may use eligible pre-2026 labels. Date membership is implemented; forecasts and scores are planned.
svg.text: Develop on earlier years. Reserve 2026 model scores.
EV-001 · 20-session volatility target · frozen final-test model
Features use information through each origin
Validate on 2023, 2024, and 2025; train each fold using eligible earlier labels.
After selection, refit with pre-2026 labels whose outcomes end before 2026.
Boundary rule: exclude any earlier label reaching the next period.
Keep incomplete outcomes explicit; primary test windows do not overlap within an instrument.
Implemented: date-membership checks · Planned: feature pipeline, forecasting, and model scores
Retrospective historical holdout; prior descriptive inspection of 2026 is disclosed.
